by
  have h_exp_neg_integrable_on_Ioi : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => Real.exp (-b * x)) (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 hb
  let f := fun x => Real.exp (-b * x)
  have h_f_integrable_on_Ioc : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn f (Set.Ioc 0 x) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    by
      rw [Set.Ioc]
      have h_f_integrable_on_Ioi : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn f (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume := h_exp_neg_integrable_on_Ioi
      have h_f_abs_integrable_on_Ioi : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => |f x|) (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        by apply MeasureTheory.integrableOn_abs_of_integrableOn h_f_integrable_on_Ioi
      have h_f_abs_integrable_on_Ioc : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => |f x|) (Set.Ioc 0 x) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        by apply MeasureTheory.integrableOn_restrict h_f_abs_integrable_on_Ioi
      exact (MeasureTheory.integrableOn_of_abs_integrableOn h_f_abs_integrable_on_Ioc)
  exact h_f_integrable_on_Ioc
